hero.title: Consultancy & Software
hero.summary: Specialist support for utility network delivery, backed by modern platforms.

items.title: Programme & Project Management
items.body: Establish and lead build programmes through structured governance, reporting cadence and delivery controls. Provide programme oversight, stakeholder management and recovery planning to keep complex deployments on track and aligned to strategic objectives.

items.title: Tender Schedules & Resource Planning
items.body: Develop end-to-end programme schedules to support bids and delivery planning, defining detailed resource requirements across field, supervisory and back-office functions. Build robust mobilisation plans aligned to programme scale, pace and delivery strategy.

items.title: Target Operating Models
items.body: Design scalable operating models through detailed process workshops, mapping end-to-end delivery workflows, interdependencies, ownership and controls. Identify process gaps, bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency gains to create streamlined, scalable delivery frameworks.

items.title: Risk & Mitigations
items.body: Implement structured risk identification, assessment and mitigation frameworks across programmes and projects. Establish clear ownership, escalation routes and tracking mechanisms to proactively manage delivery risks, minimise disruption and improve decision-making.

items.title: Deployment Advisory
items.body: Provide independent advisory support on FTTP deployment strategy, delivery models and best practice. Leverage experience from large-scale fibre programmes to improve performance, optimise contractor management and enhance delivery outcomes.
